name: kiro-code-reviewer
description: Pre-PR AI code review: prepares a redacted diff locally, sends it to the Kiro Reviewer service when you ask for a review, and shows findings with cross-iteration tracking.
author: Kiro

tools.name: code_review_prepare
tools.title: Prepare Code review payload
tools.description: Local only, no network. Collects the git diff from the merge-base of `base` and HEAD, base-revision rules and approved context files; redacts secrets; checks limits; stages the payload. Returns prepared_id, payload_digest and summaryMarkdown. Show summaryMarkdown to the user, then call code_review_submit.

repo_path.description: Absolute path of the git repository root.

context_files.description: Up to 20 repo-relative files the user approved.

include_uncommitted.description: Diff the working tree instead of HEAD (default false).

context_rounds.description: Rounds in which the reviewer may request more repository context, 0..2 per review (new reviews only; default 2; 0 opts out).

include_changed_files.description: Also send the full text of the modified and renamed files, matching include-changed-files in the GitHub action (default true; false opts out). Added files are not attached, since the diff carries them whole; deleted, binary, secret-like and non-text files are skipped. Attached files are redacted, listed in the summary and count toward the context limits; files that do not fit are skipped and listed.

include_manifest.description: Send the tracked file names (no content) so the reviewer can request context (default true).

intent.description: A short statement of what this change is meant to do, written from the task. Shown in the summary and sent to the reviewer as an untrusted author claim for lightweight spec-drift checking. Optional.

responses.description: Dispositions of the PREVIOUS iteration's findings (resubmit only). disposition in fixed | false_positive | wont_fix | deferred | question. For a BLOCKING finding you want to set aside, set acknowledged: true ONLY after the user has said "yes" in chat to that specific finding; the service records an unacknowledged blocking dismissal as a no-op. Shown to the user in the summary. Pass the array JSON-encoded as a string.

tools.name: code_review_submit
tools.title: Send staged payload to Kiro Reviewer
tools.description: Sends a payload staged by code_review_prepare to the Kiro Reviewer service. Pass prepared_id and payload_digest exactly as returned by prepare.

tools.name: code_review_get
tools.title: Get code review results
tools.description: Reads a review iteration, waiting up to wait_seconds (0..90, default 60) for a terminal status. Returns immediately with needsContext: true when the status is NEEDS_CONTEXT (call code_review_context_prepare right away). Returns structured results and Markdown. If still running, call again.

wait_seconds.description: Seconds to wait for a terminal status or an open context request (NEEDS_CONTEXT with an AWAITING round), 0..90 (default 60).

tools.name: code_review_suppress
tools.title: Suppress a code review finding
tools.description: Suppresses one finding for the rest of the review session. Only on the user’s explicit request, with a reason.

review_id.description: The review the finding belongs to.

finding_id.description: The finding to suppress, f-<16 hex>.

reason.description: Why the user suppresses it (≤ 500 chars).

tools.name: code_review_context_prepare
tools.title: Prepare context the reviewer requested
tools.description: Call when code_review_get reports NEEDS_CONTEXT. Reads the open context round (read-only GET), answers each request from the local repository (refuses paths outside the repo, under .git/ or secret-like; redacts secrets; checks limits) and stages the response. Nothing is sent. Pass decline (request ids) for anything the user does not want shared, and extra_files only when the user asks. Returns prepared_id, payload_digest, summaryMarkdown and expiresAt. Show summaryMarkdown to the user, then call code_review_context_submit.

repo_path.description: Absolute path of the git repository root.

include_uncommitted.description: Read files from the working tree instead of HEAD (default false).

decline.description: Request ids the user does not want shared; they are sent as declined.

extra_files.description: Up to 8 extra repo-relative files, only when the user asks to share them.

tools.name: code_review_context_submit
tools.title: Send staged context to Kiro Reviewer
tools.description: Sends context staged by code_review_context_prepare to the Kiro Reviewer service. Pass prepared_id and payload_digest exactly as returned by context_prepare.

tools.name: code_review_status
tools.title: Check Kiro Reviewer setup
tools.description: Read-only. Reports the endpoint and credential situation as the reviewer tools see it, and checks the service with one read. Call it when another code_review tool fails with a credential or config error, and show the result to the user.
